teacher_info.teaching_style:
My main teaching principles:
1. Make it as enjoyable as possible by building and maintaining trust with students and giving feasible instructions by splitting language practice into smaller steps 
2. Creating a context for learning
3. Natural communication, discussing the topics that are relevant to a student
4. As much as possible, I teach in the foreign language by grading it, in order to develop thinking skills in the language that I teach
5. I use a lot of visual materials, like Power point presentations, games and many other online teaching tools 
6. I ask a lot of questions to help get started but also encourage initiative and will be happy to be asked!

pro_course_detail.title: From Pre-Speech to Basic Conversation
pro_course_detail.description:
This class is designed to guide students from pre-speech stages to basic conversational skills in Portuguese. The core of this lesson is based on providing comprehensible input—language that is understandable and meaningful, even if it contains some unfamiliar words. For students at A1 to A2 levels, this comprehensible input comes from both the teacher’s speech and the materials used. The goal is to introduce students to real-life language in a way that feels natural and intuitive, drawing on Stephen Krashen’s Natural Approach to language acquisition.

The lesson starts with pre-speech activities. During this stage, students engage with simple, everyday vocabulary through context, images, and gestures. For example, they might learn common greetings like “Olá!” (Hello) or “Como vai?” (How are you?), with the teacher providing visual cues to reinforce meaning.

Following this, the class moves into a more structured yet still interactive phase, where students start practicing short sentences. During this stage, the students focus on words and phrases that are useful in daily conversations. For example, they might listen to a simple conversation, like "Qual é o seu nome?" (What’s your name?) and respond by choosing the correct answer.

Finally, we move to basic conversation practice, where students actively use the language to respond to simple questions, like "Onde você mora?" (Where do you live?). This part, lasting around 15 minutes, emphasizes speaking in short, meaningful exchanges. The focus remains on keeping input at a level that is understandable for the students, ensuring they can participate in the conversation even if it’s their first attempt.

Throughout the class, all material and teacher input are carefully chosen to align with A1 to A2 proficiency levels, promoting both understanding and practical language use. This approach ensures that students feel comfortable and supported as they develop their skills.

pro_course_detail.title: The Power of Reading: Unlocking Language Acquisition Through Texts
pro_course_detail.description:
Reading is one of the most powerful tools for language acquisition, and in this class, we’ll explore how it can transform your ability to learn Portuguese naturally and effectively. According to Stephen Krashen’s theories, reading allows you to see vocabulary and grammar in meaningful contexts, making it easier to absorb the language subconsciously. When you read, you encounter the same words and structures repeatedly, but in different situations, which helps your brain internalize them without the need for memorization or drills. Common words and phrases appear naturally through the texts, reinforcing their meaning and usage in a way that feels effortless and enjoyable.

In this class, I’ll guide you through methods to develop your reading skills in Portuguese, tailored to your level and goals. We’ll use tools like graded readers, which are books specifically designed for language learners. These texts are adapted to different proficiency levels, starting with simple vocabulary and short sentences for beginners and gradually increasing in complexity as you progress. Graded readers allow you to read for pleasure while staying within your comfort zone, ensuring comprehension and building confidence.

I’ll also help you find other written materials suited to your level, such as short stories, news articles, or even children’s books. The key is to choose texts that are interesting and comprehensible, so you stay motivated and engaged. Through guided reading activities, we’ll work on strategies like predicting content, identifying key words, and inferring meaning from context. Over time, you’ll notice your vocabulary expanding, your understanding of grammar improving, and your ability to read more complex texts growing—all while enjoying the process.

By immersing yourself in reading, you’ll not only acquire the language naturally but also develop a deeper connection with Portuguese culture and its rich literary traditions.

pro_course_detail.title: "Batendo um Papo" – Relaxed Conversations for Real Communication
pro_course_detail.description:
“Bater um papo” is a Brazilian Portuguese expression that means having a casual, friendly conversation—just like chatting with a friend over coffee. And that’s exactly what this class is about: natural, stress-free communication to help you develop your speaking skills with confidence.

According to linguist Stephen Krashen, communication is the key to language acquisition. The goal is to be understood, not to be perfect. Native speakers want to understand you, and small mistakes don’t matter as long as the message gets across. In fact, obsessing over errors can create anxiety and slow down your progress. That’s why my approach focuses on creating a low-stress, comfortable environment where you can express yourself freely.

Conversation is one of the most powerful tools for language learning because it helps your brain form strong connections between words, meanings, and real-life situations. The more you engage in meaningful discussions, the more naturally the language will come to you.

We can talk about a wide range of topics, depending on your interests. I love arts, music, literature, and cinema from all countries and periods—including silent films. I also enjoy trekking, exploring nature, and traveling to learn about different cultures. As a teacher of History, Politics, and Philosophy, I’m always up for deep and thought-provoking discussions. And if you’re into video games, board games, RPGs, or language learning (I’m currently studying French!), we can chat about those as well.

In our conversations, I’ll provide guidance when needed, introduce new vocabulary naturally, and gently correct mistakes that might affect comprehension. But above all, my goal is to make you feel comfortable and motivated to express yourself in Portuguese. Let’s have a chat and enjoy the journey of language learning together!
